profile.headline: Senior Software Sustaining Engineer
profile.geoLocationName: Rancho Santa Margarita, California, United States

positions.title: Senior Software / Sustaining Engineer
positions.description:
• Situational ePHI Awareness for Reducing Risk and Aligning with 405d Healthcare Industry Cybersecurity Practices (HICP), Cloud-based SaaS, AI/ML
• Lead management of Customer Support escalations
• First lead contact person for the client (or endpoint) side issues
• Participate in Bug Triage process
• Troubleshoot/enhance component-based client ePHI detection written in modern C++ (AppSensor and agent)
• Create Jira tickets based on my defect analysis and fix them
• Analyze agent crash dumps with Windbg, fix it or log into the Jira tickets
• Own / manage web extension written in Javascript to detect ePHI email activities and file movements to cloud
• Debug Tausight web extension Javascript with Chrome developer tools
• Manage Microsoft and Google AppStores for the Tausight web extension
• Develop CrowdStrike LogScale DB queries for status of the agents
• Complete developing and demonstration of the Remote Logging program, transferring event logs to the GCP bucket
• Collaborate with a backend engineer working on AL/ML with TensorFlow and Python for ePHI decision scores
• Help with manual QA testing
• Help design test automation with Selenium
• Participate live launch of the agent in the customer environment
positions.insights: Jira, Event Trace Logging and +23 skills

positions.title: Senior Sustaining Engineer
positions.description:
•	Lead client (endpoint) side of Customer Support escalations and issues
•	Maintain/Enhance application Single Sign On (SSO) and OneSign C++ programs 
•	Participate in customer calls for troubleshooting with support engineers
•	Participate Pre-Sales Client/Server applications for SSO - APG setup/troubleshooting
•	Defect fix, build installation files (MSI), troubleshoot application profiles (in XML format) for SSO - APG
•	Troubleshoot OneSign authentication configuration
•	Manage and ownership of Windows Hook, Web Browser Helper Object (BHO) modules
•	Develop AutoIt script to proxy credentials to ActiveX web program
•	Develop test applications for bug fixes (Windows GUI controls)
•	Advise OneSign certification program for SSO - APG feature
•	Mentor colleagues for SSO - APG related features
•	Evaluate customer applications to generate the APG (Application Profile Generator) for SSO
•	Responsible for hardening of Epic Connector C++ program
•	Responsible for Onsite critical escalation of Marquee customers (domestic and international)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Develop, delivery and implementation of Driver’s License/Identification Central Factory Systems for Governments and States (USA-9 States, UK, Philippines, Honduras, Vietnam, Costa Rica, Columbia) - C and Win32 API languages
• Design, develop, test, and deliver new technology (called PrintFarm) for Centralized OTC (Over The Counter) Driver’s license / ID programs
• Integrated new PrintFarm OTC program with 3rd party OTC printer device driver
• Develop magnetic stripe ATM encoding logic for the Connecticut EBT/MED program
• Develop multi-threading Serial Communication Base Layer, RS232, used in the Factory stations
• Develop Symbol Barcode scanner Setup program (Win32 Dialog)
• Image Processing (BMP, JPG, TIFF formats) for portraits, signatures, fingerprints, 2D/3D barcodes
• Evaluate new printer/copier machines for upgrades
• Design, participate in demonstrations of Central Factory program in Pre-Sales process
• Work with Sustaining engineers to fix bugs, troubleshoot customer support issues
• Work with electrical, mechanical engineers to integrate hardware with the Central Factory software
• Work with several different delivery teams (software/hardware) to deliver Government / State programs
• Participate in a high-level meeting about South Korean driver's license program initiative to translate Korean language
positions.insights: Print Production, On-site Services and +16 skills
